paragraphs.text: The Magic Encyclopedia is a collectible encyclopedia distributed in Spain by Salvat , a company of the Hachette group publishing company and Hasbro , parent company of Wizards of the Coast . In Italy, France and the UK it was published under the name of the Hachette Group itself. It teaches the basic concepts of the game, the rules , and other general information. The product was sold with a set of exclusive cards that form theme decks specially designed to illustrate the strategies of the game. Each issue of the encyclopedia contained a booster with 12 cards for these theme decks. The cards have their own expansion symbol featuring a Pegasus , the logo of Salvat editorial: (2005 - 2006) and (2010 - 2012).
